resources.string: By default all complications and the trip chip at the foot of the watch face show the app icon. With this the complications show their own icons instead (the state of the trip such as waiting, vehicle or walking, home, disruptions, location); the chip keeps the app icon.
Scrolling the overview of the live trip on the watch shows at the top when you will be at the row in the middle and how much time you have to change. Off: the crown just scrolls.
